sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October, looking to extend their impressive recent form. Sandbach sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and have won their last match, maintaining a strong sequence of W-D-W-W-W. They face a struggling Alsager Town side who are rooted to the bottom with just 4 points and have lost their last four games, making this a fixture where Sandbach will be heavy favorites.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a match with title-race implications; Stafford have 20 points and recent form of D-W-W-L-W-D, while Dawley sit mid-table with 11 points. AFC Bridgnorth (third, 19 points) host Eccleshall (fifth, 18 points) in a direct clash between two of the division's strongest sides. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, 19 points) visit Wednesfield Community (ninth, 13 points) in a fixture between sides occupying very different league positions. Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) host Foley Meir (13th, 11 points) on Saturday. In-form Barnton (seventh, 15 points) travel to face Shawbury United (15th, 10 points), who have endured a difficult spell. Market Drayton Town (10th, 12 points) host New Mills (eighth, 14 points) in a mid-table encounter. Crewe (16th, 9 points) entertain Allscott Heath (11th, 11 points), while at the bottom, Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th, 7 points) visit Telford Town (18th, 6 points) in a struggle between two of the division's weakest teams. Brereton Social (14th, 11 points) host Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points), with the visitors having won just once all season.
